scope: Local regression-oracle discrimination; no SDK/provider execution

runs.manual_delta: Return None for an empty number list and for a null user; retain the original normal computation.
Both functions return None for every input, preventing crashes while breaking their normal results.

limitations: All three runs used native unittest locally, with no model or SDK call.
Manual controls establish only the narrow oracle's discrimination; they are not model solutions or upstream test results.
The three stderr files retain returned output with only the private checkout prefix replaced by <checkout>. Original-output hashes are kept separately; they are not hashes of sanitized bytes.
The source fixture is transcribed from dated official documentation, not claimed to be an immutable upstream repository file.
No independent reviewer has accepted the oracle or cross-runtime capture contract.
